$schema.description: Editor hint only; ignored by the loader.

id.description: Scene id; also the ?scene= URL value.

grid.description: Size of one grid cell in metres.

target.description: Point the camera looks at, metres.

at.description: Position in grid cells (x, y, z), snapped to SCENE_SNAP_STEP.

scale.description: Stretch along the piece’s own x, y, z (e.g. a 2 m floor tile scaled 5× is 10 m).

properties.description: World properties of the piece over the level material, e.g. { "climbable": "ivy" } or a wooden material.

material.description: Material preset id (a material content entry).

freezePoint.description: Temperature at or below which it freezes, °C.

fragile.description: Impact energy that breaks it, J.

density.description: Density, kg/m³; below 1000 it floats in water.

climbable.description: Climbing grade: none, ladder, rope, ivy (easy), rough (needs a climber), sheer (needs a tool).

liftable.description: Can be picked up and carried.

hideable.description: An actor can hide in or behind it.

transparent.description: Light and sight pass through it.

impactAbsorb.description: Fraction of impact energy it absorbs, 0 … 1.

liquid.description: A liquid: it pours, puddles and can have a water surface.

flammableGas.description: A gas that ignites (flares or explodes) when fire reaches it.

extinguishable.description: A fire or light source that water, force or an interaction puts out.

waterSurface.description: Top surface of a body of liquid: cold freezes it into walkable ice (needs a liquid material).

unstable.description: Force of one push, blast or quake that topples it, J.

suspended.description: Hangs from its support; falls when the support breaks, burns or is cut.

support.description: Entity a suspended object hangs from (0 = none); set when the level spawns.

breakable.description: A single hit at or above its toughness for that kind of hit breaks it.

blunt.description: Blunt hit energy that breaks it, J.

slash.description: Slash hit energy that breaks it, J.

pierce.description: Pierce hit energy that breaks it, J.

force.description: Force (blast, quake, boulder) energy that breaks it, J.

toughness.description: Per kind of hit, the single-hit energy that breaks a breakable object; a kind left out never does.

bashable.description: A shield bash or kick shoves it (or breaks it when breakable).

cuttable.description: Slash or pierce damage severs it.

shootable.description: Projectile impulse that fires its signal, N·s.

softAnchor.description: Rope arrows and hooks embed in it.

surfaceHardness.description: Footstep loudness and whether arrows stick (soft, medium) or ricochet (hard).

chargeActivated.description: Stored charge at which the mechanism fires.

lightActivated.description: Light level on it at which the mechanism fires.

hidden.description: Not perceivable or targetable until revealed.

trapped.description: Interacting with it triggers its trap unless disarmed first (needs a trap).

trap.description: Trap definition id a trapped object triggers.

container.description: Holds items (contents live in the e18 container component).

remains.description: Inert skeletal or corpse remains that summoning can raise.

noiseMultiplier.description: Multiplier on its wearer's noise; an actor's is the product of its equipment's.

ledges.description: Ledge overrides, applied in order (a later one wins over an earlier one).

side.description: Top edge on this side of the piece (its own axes, before yaw); omit for every side.

part.description: Index of the part in the kit piece; omit for every part.

ledge.description: false: never a ledge (decoration); true: always a ledge (the whole edge).

breakable.description: Makes the piece breakable, e.g. a cracked wall the knight can smash (mw-e03.11).

profile.description: Breakable profile: resistances, debris, break loudness.

contents.description: Props it spills when it breaks (props with a body; mw-e03.39).

reveals.description: Passage it opens when it breaks: names the passageRevealed event (nav, quests).

id.description: Name of the spawn, unique in the scene (e.g. player-start).

at.description: Position in grid cells (x, y, z), snapped to SCENE_SNAP_STEP.

prop.description: Prop to spawn; without one the spawn is a marker.

tags.description: Free-form tags for systems and tools.

interact.description: Makes the spawned entity interactable: its affordances (mw-e02.5).

label.description: Prompt text; defaults to the verb (e.g. "Pull").

hold.description: Seconds Interact must be held; 0 or omitted fires on press.

requires.description: Every one must hold for the actor to use it (else shown greyed with the reason).

item.description: Item id the actor must carry (a key).

reason.description: Shown while unavailable, e.g. "Locked — needs Iron Key".

affordances.description: In priority order: Interact uses the first one the actor can.

anchor.description: Focus point relative to the entity, metres; defaults to [0, 1, 0].

radius.description: Bounding radius of the focus point, metres.

targetable.description: Makes the spawned entity a lock-on target with this profile (mw-e02.16).

item.description: Places an item here as a world item the player can take, drop and throw (mw-e17.7).

count.description: Units in the one world item (a pile of arrows); default 1.

creature.description: Creature to spawn here (mw-e12.4); faces the spawn’s yaw.

faction.description: Faction the spawned creature joins instead of its definition’s (needs creature).

patrol.description: Patrol route for the spawned creature: waypoints in grid cells, walked in order (needs creature; AI, e11, walks it).

items.description: Position in grid cells (x, y, z), snapped to SCENE_SNAP_STEP.

properties.description: World properties of the spawned entity, e.g. a torch: { "burning": true, "fuel": 3600 } (mw-e03.37). A spawn with properties is placed in the sim, so the light field and stimuli reach it.

material.description: Material preset id (a material content entry).

freezePoint.description: Temperature at or below which it freezes, °C.

fragile.description: Impact energy that breaks it, J.

density.description: Density, kg/m³; below 1000 it floats in water.

support.description: Entity a suspended object hangs from (0 = none); set when the level spawns.

breakable.description: A single hit at or above its toughness for that kind of hit breaks it.

blunt.description: Blunt hit energy that breaks it, J.

slash.description: Slash hit energy that breaks it, J.

pierce.description: Pierce hit energy that breaks it, J.

cuttable.description: Slash or pierce damage severs it.

shootable.description: Projectile impulse that fires its signal, N·s.

softAnchor.description: Rope arrows and hooks embed in it.

surfaceHardness.description: Footstep loudness and whether arrows stick (soft, medium) or ricochet (hard).

chargeActivated.description: Stored charge at which the mechanism fires.

lightActivated.description: Light level on it at which the mechanism fires.

hidden.description: Not perceivable or targetable until revealed.

trapped.description: Interacting with it triggers its trap unless disarmed first (needs a trap).

trap.description: Trap definition id a trapped object triggers.

container.description: Holds items (contents live in the e18 container component).

remains.description: Inert skeletal or corpse remains that summoning can raise.

noiseMultiplier.description: Multiplier on its wearer's noise; an actor's is the product of its equipment's.

breakable.description: Makes the spawned entity breakable, e.g. a pot that spills its contents (mw-e03.11).

profile.description: Breakable profile: resistances, debris, break loudness.

contents.description: Props it spills when it breaks (props with a body; mw-e03.39).

reveals.description: Passage it opens when it breaks: names the passageRevealed event (nav, quests).

door.description: Makes the spawned entity a door: profile, lock and starting state (mw-e03.18).

profile.description: Door profile: kind, size, speed, material, what it shuts out.

lock.description: The lock it carries: what keys, picks and spells get past.

locked.description: Starts locked; defaults to true when it has a lock (needs one).

state.description: How it starts: closed, open or jammed.

hinge.description: Hinged and trapdoor: the side the hinge is on (−x or +x before yaw); sliding: the side it slides to.

swing.description: Hinged: swings towards +z (forward) or −z (back) before yaw.

switch.description: Makes the spawned entity a lever, button, crank or wheel (mw-e03.18).

positions.description: Positions it steps through (crank and wheel; a lever has 2, a button none).

container.description: Makes the spawned entity a lootable container: loot table, contents and lock (mw-e18.3).

loot.description: Loot table rolled into it the first time it is opened (once; saves keep the result).

contents.description: What it holds from the start, before any roll.

item.description: An item it holds from the start.

lock.description: The lock it carries: unlocked and picked like a door’s (mw-e03.18).

locked.description: Starts locked; defaults to true when it has a lock (needs one).

light.description: Static lighting: ambient level, ambient zones, directional lights (mw-e03.37).

ambient.description: Ambient level wherever no ambient zone applies, 0–1.

ambientZones.description: Boxes with their own ambient level; later zones win where they overlap.

id.description: Name of the zone, e.g. moonlit-yard.

max.description: Upper corner, grid cells; above min on every axis.

directional.description: Directional lights (moon, sun); the brightest is the rendered key light.

id.description: Name of the light, e.g. moon.

direction.description: Direction the light travels, e.g. [0, -1, 0] straight down.

reach.description: How far back towards the light a position must be clear to receive it, metres.

signals.description: Signal graphs wiring its switches, volumes and doors (mw-e03.18).

bindings.description: Binding name → spawn id, for names that are not themselves spawn ids.

acoustics.description: Rooms, portals and partitions for sound propagation (mw-e09.3).

id.description: Name of the room, unique in the scene, e.g. guard-room.

max.description: Upper corner, grid cells; above min on every axis.

id.description: Name of the portal, unique in the scene, e.g. guard-room-door.

prefixItems.description: A room id of this scene, or "outside".
A room id of this scene, or "outside".

rooms.description: The two rooms it joins (one may be "outside").

at.description: Its middle, grid cells: where a listener on the far side hears a sound come from.

door.description: Spawn id of the door in it; its state (open, ajar, closed) sets the loss.

partitions.description: Materials of partitions between touching rooms; the rest use the tuning default.

material.description: Material id of what separates them; its wall or floor gain comes from the stealth tuning.
